scope: Adequacy-to-branching continuation; preserve all prior and concurrent C30/F22 content.

shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **解释充分性迫使哪些关系 / Adequacy to branching structure, 8 October 2026.** [新论证与实查](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-BRANCHING-INTEGRATION.md)新增45项 Lean 定理／141项审计：有限分支下，有限复合接续答案推出双模拟；可达且问题可区分时不需确定性就有唯一结构对应。准确约简编码导出规律，每条编码历史从任意相容原生起点提升。 / Shared-condition alternatives differ from a list of feasible words. Forward sufficiency does not recover every actual past. New 19 empty and 26 standard dependency lists, including 13 with classical choice; full audit 103 empty / 38 standard. The scope requirement is defended for formed-capacity explanation, not every local explanation or universal ontology.

**从解释责任到分支结构 / Explanatory responsibility and branching, 8 October 2026.** [最新连接](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#48-从解释对象给出保留要求)以共同条件下的后续可能性说明哪些区别不可抹去；45项 Lean 定理推出有限分支对应及不换代表拼造历史的编码规律。 / Determinism is no longer required for the scoped uniqueness result. Actual history, acquired test access and universal scope remain distinct; standard classical dependencies are disclosed.

**Explanatory-adequacy continuation, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s exact question](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md#解释为何必须保留关系--why-preserve-relations) asks why sufficient explanation must retain generative distinctions. [Source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-BRANCHING-INTEGRATION.md#8-primary-source-assessment) reads Xu–Norrish’s author-hosted modal-model-theory PDF, §§2 and 3.2. The established Hennessy–Milner route is credited; the PMC challenge and older-paper PDF timeout are recorded. Link-only assessment; no first-mechanization or independent-review claim.

**Explanatory target → branch-faithful relation, 8 October 2026.** [The 45-theorem continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-BRANCHING-INTEGRATION.md) defends common-condition continuation questions for explanations of formed capacities. Under finite branching, their complete finite-test answers force bisimulation; reachable separated realizations have a bijective correspondence without determinism. Exact reduced codes yield a law whose full finite histories lift from every compatible native start. Forward adequacy cannot reconstruct all actual provenance. This advances the target-to-necessary-content inference at a stated scope, without making every local explanation answer all tests or proving a unique ontology. Audits: 45 new / 141 total, 103 empty and 38 standard; the new general converse uses classical dependencies.

C30.title_zh: 生成关系的解释必要性
C30.claim_zh: 独立指定的取得、错误与后续问题要求保留实际差异和共同边界；接合探针进一步恢复有限片段接口，三元关系唯一确定局部单位，完整有限轨迹恢复其状态接口。整体表述仍合格，容量反例限定接口匹配的充分性。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。
C30.claim_en: Independently specified acquisition, error and continuation questions require native distinctions and shared boundaries. Joining probes further recover finite-fragment interfaces; the ternary relation determines unique unit roles, and complete finite traces recover their state interfaces. Global accounts remain eligible; capacity limits matching-unit sufficiency. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness.
C30.scope_zh: 此前各轮及实际展开42项定理／64项新审计保留原范围与独立评审；本轮另54项（23＋31）／128项含继承审计：105空、23仅propext。探针可用性、状态内容及完整接续条件明示；共享容量／并行冲突下的定义域与输出识别仍待推进。 新增14项定理／18项空依赖审计，另192项继承依赖不变（150空、42标准）；独立审查接受。既有温控／氧梯度证据接入，但不等于该构造的物理实现或普遍根基完成；重叠继承不累加。 此独立一轮61项新定理／135项审计（123空、12继承propext；新61项全空）。已有14项有效规律推导保留；普遍目标为何必须区分相关原生关系仍未证，有限反例不整体否定普遍猜想。
C30.scope_en: Earlier studies, including native unfolding (42 theorems / 64 new audits and its independent review), retain their scopes. This separate 54 (23+31) / 128 audit study has 105 empty and 23 propext-only lists. Probe access, state content and completion are explicit; identification with shared-capacity/concurrent conflicts remains open. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture.
